content:
Apple will launch several new Macs later this year, including the first MacBook with a touch screen, the first computers powered by the M6 chip, and more. Here's what's known so far about the upcoming new Macs.

MacBook Ultra

The flagship Mac launching later this year will be Apple's first-ever MacBook with a touch screen. Whether this new machine will be named MacBook Pro or MacBook Ultra remains to be seen, but it will be the biggest MacBook Pro redesign in years.

Apple is reportedly testing this high-end MacBook model running macOS 27.1, with a launch expected in late October.

This all-new MacBook model will be Apple's first laptop to feature both a touch screen and an OLED display. It is also expected to drop the current notch design in favor of a Dynamic Island-style design similar to the iPhone. Bloomberg also reports that the new high-end MacBook will be thinner than the current MacBook Pro.

In terms of performance, the new touch-screen MacBook will retain the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips currently found in the MacBook Pro lineup.

M6 MacBook

Apple is reportedly planning to launch its first M6-powered Mac later this year. The company is developing an updated entry-level MacBook Pro featuring the next-generation M6 processor.

According to reports, the M6 will offer faster memory bandwidth and improvements in both CPU and GPU core performance.

Aside from the M6 chip, the new entry-level MacBook Pro is not expected to see any other changes.

iMac

Apple's last update to the 24-inch iMac was in October 2024, when it upgraded from the M3 to the M4 chip. Apple is now working on the next-generation iMac update, which is reportedly expected to launch this fall.

The new iMac is expected to feature Apple's upcoming M6 chip. There are also rumors that the new iMac will offer a brand-new range of color options.

Mac mini and Mac Studio (possibly)

Finally, Apple is also working on updates to the Mac mini and Mac Studio, but the release dates for these two machines remain unclear.

For the Mac mini, Apple is reportedly testing a new product lineup powered by the M5 Pro and entry-level M6 chips. As for the Mac Studio, it is being tested with M5 Max and M5 Ultra processors.

According to Bloomberg, the release dates for these machines are still unclear and will depend on "memory chip supply conditions." The general expectation is that the new Mac Studio will launch before the end of this year, but it remains uncertain for now.

For reference, the current Mac mini is available with M4 and M4 Pro chips, while the Mac Studio comes in M4 Max and M3 Ultra configurations.

Summary

Affected by tight memory and storage chip supplies across the industry, Apple's Mac lineup is currently in a rather awkward position. However, the company still has a strong slate of new machines ready to go. What do you think of the new Macs launching before the end of this year? How much do you think the MacBook Ultra will be priced at? Let us know in the comments.
